purpose: Stage 3 Z-dissection of the inhibitory cell under the command-only input datum (Stage 0 forensics): per-boundary charge per spike cycle for source and candidate, then reversible removal of one boundary at a time. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-06-h01-energetic-isolation-plan.md.
holdout: 0.23 nA (active-1.npz) is not an input of any stage.
evaluation: One parameter set at both spiking calibration inputs with every current probe on.

subsystems.SK axon: scale_conductance SK, factor 0, region axon (the candidate's NaTg x1.1 soma is dropped in this arm)
subsystems.SK all: scale_conductance SK, factor 0, region all (same note)

R.title: Reference charge budgets, source and candidate, command-only input
R.prediction: Source: 11 spikes at 0.19 nA and about 46 at 0.27 nA, first-spike loop as in h01-pv-neuron-space9 (peak +44 mV). Candidate: 15 and 43 spikes, loop on the human's, minimum -73 mV. Charge closure residual per cycle below 1e-4 pC. In the candidate the potassium plus axial charge in the falling phase is smaller than in the source by a fraction that matches the 5.5 mV shallower minimum through the soma capacitance.
R.rejection: If the closure residual exceeds 1e-3 pC in any cycle, the budget is not trusted and the probes are re-checked before Stage X. If the candidate's falling-phase outward charge is not smaller than the source's, the minimum-depth mechanism is not a charge deficit and the prediction fails.
R.unchanged: HL5BN1 donor geometry, kv3-phase-reference library, nseg x9, CVode 1e-10, 270-1270 ms pulse, bias 0.

X.title: Reversible removal of one boundary at a time on the candidate
X.prediction: Removing somatic Kv3 deepens nothing and broadens the spike; removing somatic Ca_LVA changes the first cycle only; removing axonal SK lengthens no early cycle but shortens the late cycles and lifts the late minimum; the boundary whose removal moves the minimum by more than the Stage 1 limit (1.24 mV combined) is the Steep boundary.
X.rejection: If no single removal moves the minimum beyond the limit, the minimum is set by the sodium boundary's closing charge (the G1a lever) and Stage D tests it by swap against the zero-bias source.
X.unchanged: As Stage R; one boundary changed per arm.

D.title: Swap of the Steep boundary between the zero-bias source (high system for the loop return) and the candidate
D.prediction: Restoring the source's somatic Kv3 closing in the candidate moves the trough Kv3 current from 0.04 toward 0.2 nA and the minimum from -73.3 toward -77 mV (26 MOhm trough load); the reverse swap raises the source's minimum from -77.4 toward -73 mV. Both arms leave peak and rise inside the human limits of their own model.
D.rejection: If neither arm moves the minimum by more than 1.24 mV (Stage 1 combined limit), the Kv3 closing rate is not the lever for the trough and the remaining outward boundary (K_P or SK at the soma) is named for the reserve. If the candidate arm reaches within 1.24 mV of -79 mV the row passes and the explanation is sufficient.

E.title: Interdependency split within the Kv3 boundary: fast opening, slow closing, sodium closing fixed
E.prediction: With the sodium closing fixed by the loop, the potassium boundary must activate within the short spike and stay open into the trough: opening tau halved (tau factor 0.5) with closing slowed (close factor 2 and 4, i.e. closing tau 1x and 2x the source's). Predicted trough Kv3 0.07 and 0.12 nA, minimum about -76.5 and -79 mV at 0.19 nA (117 MOhm trough slope from the Ca_LVA arm); the maximum fall rate slows and may leave the human limit (-336 +/- 20 V/s) in the close-4 arm. If the trough reaches -79 within 1.24 mV while the fall stays inside its limit, the explanation is sufficient; if the fall breaks first, the human's repolarising conductance is not a single Kv3 kinetics and the row returns to the user.
E.rejection: Neither arm moves the minimum beyond 1.24 mV: the trough is not set by somatic Kv3 activation at all and the remaining outward boundaries (K_P, dendritic load) go to the user with the reserve.
E.unchanged: As Stage R; only somatic Kv3 closing changed.
